mobile.setup.quote_unread.note: No upstream refresh or mutation from poll; explicit fresh plan/run only.

mobile.setup.corrupt_intent.note: Keep original journal untouched; no account fallback/repair or raw private JSON/error detail. Validation precedes reads/writes upstream.

mobile.setup.title_repoint.role: Phone setup title, progress, consent or recovery
mobile.setup.title_repoint.note: Account identity already masked; IDs/prices/commands stay verbatim. Subscription activation only at exact fresh monthly quote. No automatic credit purchase; completed billing/reservation is not rolled back. Provider sign-in/terms remain human. Status is read-only. This title names a BLOCKED state whose repair is local: the tunnel pins a sign-in row that is dead or gone while a provable newer row for the same account is on this device.

mobile.setup.repoint.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim; quote is fresh USD monthly activation price. The action re-points an EXISTING tunnel at an EXISTING local sign-in for the same account: no new sign-in, no new subscription, no account change, and no change to the phone address (only the pinned credential row id moves).

mobile.setup.repointed.note: A completed local re-point, not a new sign-in or activation. {id} is the credential ROW id the tunnel now pins (a local store row id, never an account id, email or phone address); it stays verbatim.

mobile.setup.disabled.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. The tunnel's owner switched it off in the Radient web console; the only fix is the console, and setup deliberately does not re-enable it.

mobile.setup.billing_lapsed.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Billing was activated before but the prepaid balance no longer covers it. The fix is adding credit, not accepting a price again.

mobile.setup.reconnect.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Shown beside a Reconnect action for a suspended tunnel whose billing is fine; running it charges nothing.

mobile.setup.network.role: Mobile setup progress or blocker (no action button)
mobile.setup.network.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Radient could not be reached or timed out; recovery is automatic, so the sentence must not ask the reader to do anything.

mobile.setup.radient_unavailable.role: Mobile setup progress or blocker (no action button)
mobile.setup.radient_unavailable.note: No OAuth, purchase or service mutation implied by observation. Commands/IDs/URL stay verbatim. Radient answered HTTP 5xx; recovery is automatic, so the sentence must not ask the reader to do anything.

mobile.setup.reconnecting.note: Shown while the automatic no-spend reconnect that runs after a Radient sign-in holds the setup lock. It must say nothing is charged and that no action is needed.

mobile.setup.login_offer.role: One-line TUI note after a successful Radient sign-in on a machine without phone access
mobile.setup.login_offer.note: Shown once per sign-in. /mobile enable is a slash command and stays verbatim. The money clause must survive: nothing is charged without the user first seeing the price.
